items.docs: Retrieve the number of active users that logged in during the last 30 days.

params.name: from
params.description: Optional first day of the date range (inclusive) in YYYYMMDD format.

params.name: to
params.description: Optional last day of the date range (inclusive) in YYYYMMDD format.

items.docs: Retrieve the number of logins, signups and breached-password detections (subscription required) that occurred each day within a specified date range.
